page.overview:
Who is Alphabittle?

Alphabittle is a male unicorn pony and supporting character in the My Little Pony Generation 5 film My Little Pony: A New Generation and subsequent Generation 5 media. He is a resident of the wooded unicorn village of Bridlewood and owner/bartender at the Crystal Tea Room establishment. In Family Trees Pt. 2, he is revealed to be Misty's father.

He is called Alphabittle Blossomforth in merchandise and the hour-long special My Little Pony: Winter Wishday.__TOC__

Alphabittle shares his first name with a G3 Earth pony mare and his last name with another G3 Earth pony mare and a G4 Pegasus mare.

In the film My Little Pony: A New Generation, Alphabittle appears as the owner and bartender of the Crystal Tea Room, a dining establishment in the unicorn village of Bridlewood; he also plays betting games as a side business and never loses. In their quest for the three Unity Crystals, Sunny Starscout and her friends (disguised as unicorns) approach Alphabittle for the Unicorn Crystal. Sunny challenges Alphabittle to a contest for the crystal, wagering the Pegasus Crystal against it, and Alphabittle accepts the challenge. He chooses a Dance Dance Revolution-like game as the contest, which typically requires three wins, but Alphabittle agrees to surrender the Unicorn Crystal if Sunny can beat him just once.
